unit.why: A single narrative about the Berdichever and the Maggid of Kozienice racing to blow the shofar on Rosh Hashanah, resolved by a heavenly dream.

stories.start_quote: הרה״ק מבארדיטשוב הי' אצל הרה״ק המגיד
stories.summary_en: The Berdichever, told by the Maggid of Kozienice that he prays earlier, wagers he will blow the shofar first; on Rosh Hashanah the Maggid falls asleep and in a dream sees in heaven that the Berdichever's immersion before the shofar blowing has broken all the accusations, so he decides to wait until the Berdichever has blown.

quotes: עדי נרדם בשינה ובתוך שינתו ראה כי עומד בשמים
